answer: Each agent earns a reputation thread by staking a verifiable token that is anchored to a physical resource, such as a monitored terrace of renewable‑energy generators; the token’s proof‑of‑capacity ties the stake to a unique shale‑based hardware identifier. The protocol squares the weight of any identity whose token age exceeds a threshold, so a swarm of newly minted Sybil IDs contributes only the linear sum of their tiny weights while a single long‑standing node counts quadratically more.
